question: Should Telegram suppress all system-marked and compaction-notice payloads, or preserve documented notifyUser notices and only suppress a narrower typed notice class?
rationale: The current patch chooses a channel policy that conflicts with documented opt-in compaction notices and with shared system-message formatting, so maintainer intent is needed if that contract should change.

options.title: Preserve NotifyUser Contract
options.body: Require the PR to keep configured compaction notices deliverable and add a typed/narrow suppression signal for only the unwanted Telegram notice class.

options.title: Approve Broad Suppression
options.body: Accept that Telegram users who opted into notifyUser and visible system statuses will stop seeing those messages, and update docs/tests accordingly before merge.

options.title: Pause For Repro Context
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the contributor provides the exact unwanted notice scenario and redacted Telegram proof showing the desired boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve NotifyUser Contract
recommendation.body: Require the PR to keep configured compaction notices deliverable and add a typed/narrow suppression signal for only the unwanted Telegram notice class.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is tied to the notifyUser config review path and adjacent Telegram delivery history, so they are a reasonable routing owner for the contract decision.
